On the 29th April and the 1st May 1940, the undersigned and D.S.I. Yu Chen Mo, proceeded to the Police Hospital, where a statement was taken from Loo Tsung Hung. With the exception, that on these occasions he denied having fired at the deceased, no new information was obtained. He reiterated the reasons which motivated the assassination, but gave no clue which might lead to the tracing of his accomplices.

Judging from the statement made by the late Supt. Tan's chauffeur, and the ballistic's report it would appear that Loo Tsung Hung was the man who fired the first shot at the deceased. His reason for denying this is rather obscure especially when it is remembered that at the time of his arrest he was found to be armed with a .38 Smith & Wesson revolver from which one bullet had been fired. Later it was ascertained by D.S.I. Ewins of the Arms Identification Section that the revolver was incapable of firing more than one shot owing to the fact that the cylinder could not rotate as the pawl guide was out of order.

As the late Supt. Tan's chauffeur cannot definitely identify the man Loo Tsung Hung, there is

根据已故谭巡官司机的陈述以及弹道报告，看来罗正洪是向死者开第一枪的人。他否认这一点的理由相当模糊，特别是考虑到他被捕时被发现持有一支.38口径的史密斯威森左轮手枪，且该枪已发射过一发子弹。后来经军械鉴定科副督察长尤因斯（Ewins）查明，由于棘爪导向装置故障导致转轮无法旋转，该左轮手枪只能发射一发子弹。

page_data.en:
Loo Tsung Hung (羅正洪), age 29, single, N.F.A.
Anhwei                                  xx        D.S.I. Hu Chen Mo
Police Hospital          1-5-40         translated            K. P. Tsaug

I was born at Wuhu, Anhwei Province. I do not know
the name of my father, as I was only three years old when he
died. My mother, Loo Li Sz (羅李氏), maintained her
livelihood by farming and at the age of thirteen I helped her
to work in the fields.

At the end of March 1939, following the maltreatment
of the inhabitants by the Japanese Military in the Wuhu Area,
I was summoned to Shanghai by one Wong Tien Hai (王言海),
a fellow countryman of mine, who employed me as his assistant
for manufacturing and selling salt at his home located at a
straw hut off Rockhill Avenue, Western District. I received
a monthly wage of $5.00 and was accommodated with board and
lodging.

During July 1939, whilst I was engaged in manufacturing
salt together with 4 other assistants (names unknown), a party
of more than ten "Ta Tao" Policemen came to our shop and after
accusing us of smuggling salt, took all five of us to Pah Hoo
Sub Station, where we were detained for three days. We were
then removed to the Ta Tao Police Headquarters at Pestang,
but were released the same afternoon after Wong Tien Hai had
paid a fine of $100.00. As a result of this setback, Wong
ceased to operate his business.

At the end of October 1939 (20-10-39 or 21-10-39)
I visited No. 267 Route Tenant de la Rue, where my fellow
countryman named Yuen Shing Loong (袁兴隆) operated a
"Servants Employment Agency", with the intention of requesting
a loan from him to enable me to return to my native country.
page_data.zh:
罗正洪（羅正洪），29岁，未婚，无固定职业。
安徽                                  xx        副督察长 胡振模
警务处医院          1940年5月1日         翻译            K. P. Tsaug

我出生于安徽省芜湖。我不知道父亲的名字，因为他去世时我只有三岁。我的母亲罗李氏（Loo Li Sz）靠务农维持生计，我十三岁时便帮她在田间劳作。

1939年3月底，继日军在芜湖地区虐待居民之后，我被一位同乡王言海（Wong Tien Hai）召至上海，在他位于西区罗别根路（Rockhill Avenue）旁一处草棚的家中受雇为其助手，从事制盐和售盐工作。我每月工资为5.00元，并提供食宿。

1939年7月间，当我与其他四名助手（姓名不详）一起从事制盐工作时，十多名“大道”警察来到我们的店铺，指控我们走私食盐，并将我们五人全部带至帕霍分巡捕房（Pah Hoo Sub Station），拘留了三天。随后我们将被移至贝当路（Pestang）的大道警察总局，但在王言海缴纳了100.00元罚款后，于当天下午获释。由于此次挫折，王言海停止了经营。

1939年10月底（10月20日或21日），我前往坦尼埃路（Route Tenant de la Rue）267号，我的同乡袁兴隆（Yuen Shing Loong）在那里经营一家“佣工介绍所”，我打算向他借款以便返回家乡。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

He was absent at the time and I waited there as late as
12 m.n., but he failed to show up. In view of the curfew
restrictions I was compelled to pass the night in the shop.
However, at about 1.30 a.m. a party of French Police,
accompanied by Japanese Gendarmes, came to the shop and took
me into custody together with 3 other males and 2 females on
suspicion of being concerned in anti-Japanese activities.
We were released owing to lack of evidence after being
detained at the Police Station for one week. About 4 or 5
days later I was strolling in some locality in the French
Concession when Wu Ching Sung (吴金生) (1st accused -
deceased), a fellow countryman of mine, accosted me and after
explaining that he was a member of a guerilla unit operating
at Soochow, stated that he arrived in Shanghai a few days ago
for the purpose of performing a certain task. He asked me
where I was living and whether I had any job, and I duly told
him what had occurred to me since I lost my job. He then
asked me if I would be willing to take part in guerilla
activities, to which I promptly agreed. After an elapse of
4 or 5 days Wu Ching Sung came to my place of abode at
Beechill Avenue and took me to Tung Ting Shan Hill, Soochow,
where, through his introduction, I was enlisted as a member
of the 84th Regiment of the 59th Division Guerilla Unit,
the Commander of which was known to be one named Van Xiang
Keh (花祥高); whilst the officer in charge of my regiment
was Captain Tsang Kung Ping (张根银). After one month's
training I was despatched to various places in Soochow,
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

当时他不在，我一直等到午夜12点，但他仍未出现。鉴于宵禁限制，我被迫在店内过夜。然而，大约在凌晨1点30分，一队法国警察在日本宪兵的陪同下来到店内，以涉嫌参与反日活动为由，将我和另外三名男性及两名女性一并拘捕。我们在警局被拘留一周后，因证据不足获释。大约四五天后的某一天，我在法租界某处闲逛时，遇到我的同乡吴金生（Wu Ching Sung）（第一被告 - 已故），他上前与我搭讪，并解释说他是苏州一带游击队的一员，几天前抵达上海是为了执行某项任务。他问我住在哪里以及是否有工作，我便如实告知了失业以来的遭遇。随后他问我是否愿意参加游击活动，我当即同意。过了四五天，吴金生来到我在毕启尔路（Beechill Avenue）的住处，带我前往苏州洞庭山，经他介绍，我加入了第59师游击队第84团，该团指挥官据称为花祥高（Van Xiang Keh）；而我所在团的负责人是张根银（Tsang Kung Ping）上尉。经过一个月的训练后，我被派往苏州各地，

page_data.en:
- 3 -

where I actually participated in guerilla warfare against
Japanese troops on three occasions.

On the 5-4-40, Captain Tseng told me that orders
had been received from Division Commander Van Chiang Koh that
we were to leave for Shanghai the following day to undertake
the task of assassinating Chinese traitors. The next morning
(6-4-40), Captain Tseng, Yu Ching Sung, Yue Dah (俞大), one
other member (name unknown) and I came to Shanghai together
by train. On the night of our arrival Yu Ching Sung and I
put up at a small lodging house, whilst the other 3 men
lived elsewhere. The following day (7-4-40) we removed to
another lodging house. Since our arrival we moved daily from
one lodging house to another. Shortly before noon on the
12-4-40 Captain Tseng came to our room and informed us that
he had secured the necessary firearms which would be used the
next morning to assassinate a traitor, whose name he however
did not mention. He also invited us to attend a performance
at the Crystal Theatre, Boulevard de Montigny, at 8 p.m. the
same night. At the appointed hour we went to the theatre
accordingly, where Captain Tseng, Yue Dah and the other member
of our regiment were also present. After the show Captain
Tseng took Yu Ching Sung and myself to a small lodging house
situated to the east of the Crystal Theatre, where, after
instructing us to stay in a small room which he had engaged
beforehand, he departed abruptly. At about 8 a.m. the
following day (13-4-40) Captain Tseng came to the room in
company of Yue Dah and the other member, and on this occasion
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

在那里我实际参与了三次对抗日军的游击战。

1940年4月5日，曾上尉告诉我，接到师长范江科（Van Chiang Koh）的命令，我们要于次日前往上海，执行刺杀汉奸的任务。第二天早上（4月6日），曾上尉、余庆松（Yu Ching Sung）、俞大（Yue Dah）、另一名成员（姓名不详）和我一同乘火车来到上海。到达当晚，余庆松和我住进了一家小旅馆，而其他三人则住在别处。第二天（4月7日），我们搬到了另一家旅馆。自到达以来，我们每天都从一个旅馆搬到另一个旅馆。1940年4月12日中午前不久，曾上尉来到我们的房间，通知我们他已经搞到了必要的枪支，将于次日上午用于刺杀一名汉奸，但他并未提及该人的姓名。他还邀请我们当晚8点去蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）的水晶大戏院观看演出。在约定时间，我们 accordingly 前往剧院，曾上尉、俞大以及我们团的其他成员也在那里。演出结束后，曾上尉带余庆松和我去了位于水晶大戏院东侧的一家小旅馆，在指示我们待在他预先包下的一个小房间里后，他便匆匆离去。第二天（4月13日）早上约8点，曾上尉与俞大及另一名成员来到房间，在这次

page_data.en:
- 4 -

he openly declared that we were going to kill a traitor named
Tan, who was a high ranking Chinese employee of the S.M.P.
and who was believed to receive $3,000.00 per month from the
Japanese authorities for services rendered to them, such as
(1) to facilitate the extradition of Chinese patriots arrested
by the S.M.P., (2) to secure the immediate release of pro-
Japanese elements in custody of the S.M.P. and (3) to supply
information to the Japanese authorities. Captain Tsang further
stated that he had been investigating into the activities of
this man for the past six months and the persons he detailed
to carry out the assassination on numerous occasions had failed
in every instance. He added that he would be severely
punished by his superiors should this attempt again prove to
be abortive and therefore requested us to exert ourselves to
the utmost in bringing the case to a successful conclusion.
After producing two revolvers, he gave one to me and the other
to Wu Ching Sung, stating that he, Tse Sah and the other member
were each armed with a Mauser pistol. At 8.30 a.m. (13-6-40)
the five of us left the lodging house and proceeded to S. Ming
Tsung alleyway, Avenue Foch, F.C., under the leadership of
Captain Tsang. We arrived there at about 9 a.m. and whilst
Captain Tsang, Tse Sah and the other member entered the
alleyway, Wu Ching Sung and I kept a close watch outside.
They came out of the alleyway a short while later when Captain
Tsang told us that the victim's m/car had been driven to the
roadway and asked us to follow him quickly. We then crossed
the road to the Settlement side and were led to the entrance of
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

他公开宣布我们要去杀一个叫谭的汉奸，此人是工部局警务处的高级华员，据信因向日本当局提供服务而每月收取3,000.00元，这些服务包括：(1) 协助引渡被工部局警务处逮捕的中国爱国者，(2) 确保被工部局警务处羁押的亲日分子立即获释，以及 (3) 向日本当局提供情报。曾上尉进一步表示，他在过去六个月里一直在调查此人的活动，而他多次指派执行暗杀任务的人员均告失败。他补充说，如果这次行动再次失败，他将受到上级的严厉惩罚，因此要求我们竭尽全力使案件成功结案。拿出两支左轮手枪后，他给了我一支，另一支给了吴金生，并称他自己、谢萨（Tse Sah）和另一名成员各配备一支毛瑟手枪。上午8点30分（原文误写为1940年6月13日，应为4月13日），我们五人在曾上尉的带领下离开旅馆，前往法租界霞飞路（Avenue Foch）的圣明宗弄（S. Ming Tsung alleyway）。我们大约在上午9点到达那里，当曾上尉、谢萨和另一名成员进入弄堂时，吴金生和我在外面严密监视。不久他们从弄堂出来，曾上尉告诉我们受害者的汽车已开到马路上，让我们快跟上。于是我们穿过马路来到租界一侧，被带到

page_data.en:
- 5 -

the 1st S.S.D. Court, Weihaiwei Road, where Captain Tsang
pointed out to us the car which was parked to the east of
the entrance on the north side of the road, stating that the
traitor in question would soon come out to take the car. He
instructed Wu Ching Sung and myself to proceed immediately to
the corner of Weihaiwei and Seymour Roads to act as look-outs,
adding that should there be any interference on the part of
the Police, we could simply shout to them that we were
shooting a traitor and were not robbers. We went to this
intersection accordingly, and stood at a place about 20 yards
to the east of Seymour Road (north footpath on Weihaiwei
Road). After waiting there for 4 or 5 minutes, we saw a man
in foreign dress emerging from the back door of a house
opposite the S.S.D. Court, whereupon Captain Tsang, Yee Dah
and the other member went forward and fired 7 or 8 shots at
the man, who instantly fell to the ground. The three of them
escaped in an easterly direction and when reaching the south-
west corner of Weihaiwei and Seymour Roads they encountered
a Chinese Policeman and immediately opened fire on him.
I, however, did not fire any shots and placed the pistol in
my pocket. Accompanied by Wu Ching Sung, I hurriedly ran
after the other three persons, who fled south along Seymour
Road and then turned east into Avenue Foch. At this juncture
I became aware that we were being pursued by the Police and
my four comrades opened fire at once to resist arrest. We
rushed across Avenue Foch into French Concession and continued
our escape along Route Cardinal Mercier. The Police returned
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

威海卫路第一特区法院门口，曾上尉向我们指出了停在路北入口东侧的汽车，并称那名汉奸很快就会出来上车。他指示吴金生和我立即前往威海卫路与西摩路（Seymour Roads）的拐角处担任望风，并补充说，如果警察进行干涉，我们可以直接向他们喊话，说我们是在射击汉奸而非抢劫。我们 accordingly 前往该路口，站在西摩路以东约20码的地方（威海卫路北侧人行道）。在那里等了四五分钟后，我们看到一个身穿西式服装的人从特区法院对面一栋房屋的后门出来，随即曾上尉、俞大和另一名成员上前向那人开了七八枪，那人立刻倒地。这三人向东逃窜，当到达威海卫路与西摩路的西南角时，他们遇到了一名中国警察，并立即向其开火。然而，我没有开任何枪，并将手枪放入口袋。在吴金生的陪同下，我急忙追赶其他三人，他们沿西摩路向南逃跑，然后向东转入霞飞路。此时我意识到我们正被警察追捕，我的四名同伴立即开火以抗拒逮捕。我们冲过霞飞路进入法租界，并沿着梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）继续逃跑。警察回

page_data.en:
- 6 -

fire at this point and while the 4 others ran towards the
south, I turned east into Rue Ratard, but after having
covered a distance of several hundred yards I was shot in the
buttock and immediately afterwards a Chinese Policeman came
up and after a brief struggle, succeeded in throwing me onto
the ground. He then got on top of me and seized the revolver
from my pocket. I told him that I was not a robber, but was
detailed to kill a traitor. I then asked him for whom he was
working, and was told that he was attached to the S.M. Police.
At this moment another policeman arrived on the scene and
without hesitation fired one shot into my right leg. The
policeman who actually arrested me reprimanded him for
firing the shot when I had already been brought under control.
The latter then walked away. Subsequently a party of Foreign
and Chinese detectives arrived and took me to the Police
Station, after which I was conveyed to a hospital, where in
a ward I saw that Wu Ching Sung was likewise arrested after
being wounded during the shooting affray. He, however,
succumbed to his injuries at about 3 a.m. the following day
(14-4-40).

The above is my true statement.

Sgd., Crossexamined & Thumbprinted by : Lee Tsung Hung.

〔此处为手写签名〕

在此处开火，当另外四人向南逃跑时，我向东转入拉达路（Rue Ratard），但在跑了几百码后，我的臀部中弹，随即一名中国警察赶上来，经过短暂的搏斗，成功将我摔倒在地。随后他压在我身上，从我口袋里夺走了左轮手枪。我告诉他我不是强盗，而是受命去刺杀一名汉奸。接着我问他为谁工作，得知他隶属于工部局警务处（S.M. 以上是我的真实陈述。

Following the recognition by Det. Inspr.
Maron, attached to French Police Headquarters, of the
2nd accused as a person who was arrested at No. 267
Route Tenant de la Tour, French Concession, on the
31-10-39, at the request of the Japanese Gendarmerie
on suspicion of having been concerned in the attempted
assassination, which forms the subject of Loun F.I.R.
3963/39, efforts were made to arrest the other persons
who were arrested and subsequently released in
connection with this case.

As it was thought that the undermentioned
three male Chinese, who were arrested at the same time
as the 2nd accused on the 31-10-39, may have had
something to do with the murder of the late Supt. Tan,
efforts were made to locate them at their last known
addresses :-

1. Chang Ke Fah (張可榿), 36 years, Native of Anhwei.
2. Chew Tseng Xiang (周增祥), 29 years, Native of Anhwei.
3. Chang Hai Sheng (張海生), 30 years, Native of Anhwei.

It was however found that all the men had
removed. Two females named Loh Chang Sa (陸張氏) and
Tan Chang Sa (范張氏), sisters of Chang Hai Sheng,
were, however, located at their respective homes

继隶属于法租界警察总部的马隆（Maron，音译）侦探督察辨认出第二被告即为1939年10月31日在法租界陶尔美路（Route Tenant de la Tour）267号被捕之人（当时应日本宪兵队要求，因涉嫌参与未遂刺杀案，即娄山关档案 Loun F.I.R. 3963/39 所述案件）后，警方努力逮捕与此案有关、此前曾被捕但随后获释的其他人员。

由于认为以下三名华籍男子与1939年10月31日同第二被告一起被捕，可能与谭巡官（Supt. Tan）遇害案有关，警方试图在其最后已知住址寻找他们：-

1. 张可榿（Chang Ke Fah），36岁，安徽籍。
2. 周增祥（Chew Tseng Xiang），29岁，安徽籍。
3. 张海生（Chang Hai Sheng），30岁，安徽籍。

然而发现这些人均已搬离。不过，在海生两名分别名为陆张氏（Loh Chang Sa，音译）和范张氏（Tan Chang Sa，音译）的姐妹家中找到了她们，地址分别为

page_data.en:
2/2

situated at 19 Albert Terrace, Avenue du Roi Albert,
F.C. and 183 Rue Lemaire, F.C. These women were
handed over by Det. Inspr. Maron for questioning
regarding the present whereabout of their brother.
They were continuously questioned on this
subject but no information of value was obtained,
they maintaining that they had not seen their brother
since he left for Anwhoi shortly after his release
by the French Police. In view of this, they were
released at about 11 p.m. 13-4-40.
C.P.C. 2556, who was shot in the stomach when
he attempted to arrest the escaping assassins,
succumbed to his injuries at the Police Hospital at
about 12.45 a.m. 14-4-40.
The 1st accused Wu Ching Sung (吴金生), who
was seriously wounded whilst he was attempting to
escape from the scene of the crime, died at about
3 a.m. on the 14-4-40.
Both bodies were removed to the Public
Mortuary pending an inquest.
At inquests, conducted by Prosecutor Tsang
Tseong Wu, held at the Public Mortuary, Kingchow Road,
on the bodies of the late C.P.C. 2556 and the 2nd
accused, the following verdicts were rendered :-

法租界阿尔伯特亲王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）19号阿尔伯特台（Albert Terrace）以及法租界雷米埃路（Rue Lemaire）183号。这些妇女由马隆侦探督察移交，以便就其兄弟的下落进行讯问。就此问题对她们进行了连续讯问，但未获得有价值的情报，她们坚称自其兄弟被法国警察释放后不久前往安徽以来，就再未见过他。鉴于此，她们于1940年4月13日晚上11点左右被释放。
华警第2556号（C.P.C. 2556）在试图逮捕逃逸刺客时腹部中弹，于1940年4月14日凌晨12点45分左右在警察医院因伤重不治身亡。
第一被告吴金生（Wu Ching Sung）在试图从犯罪现场逃跑时受重伤，于1940年4月14日凌晨3点左右死亡。
两具尸体均被移至公共殓房，以待验尸审讯。
由检察官曾仲武（Tsang Tseong Wu，音译）主持，在金州路（Kingchow Road）公共殓房对华警第2556号及第二被告的尸体进行的验尸审讯中，作出了如下裁决：-

page_data.en:
2/3

1. The late C.P.C. 2556 - Death due to bullet
wounds. Body to be removed by deceased's
wife Chang Tsoong Sz for burial.
2. Prisoner Woo Ching Sang - Death due to bullet
wounds, inflicted on him by the Police whilst
he was resisting arrest. Body to be removed
by S.P.B.C. for burial.

No autopsy was deemed necessary on the body
of the late C.P.C. 2556, he having sustained a through
and through wound.

At the autopsy performed on the body of the
1st accused the Court Doctor, one .45 Revolver bullet
was removed from the head of the deceased.

Although efforts were made, the bullet which
penetrated the stomach could not be found.

The finding of this .45 revolver bullet
would indicate that it was fired from the "Webley"
revolver carried by S.P.C. 671, attached to Changta Rd.

During the morning of the 14-4-46, the

late Supt. Tam's eldest son and daughter to their

鉴于已故华警第2556号遭受的是贯通伤，认为无需对其尸体进行尸检。

在对第一被告尸体进行的尸检中，法院医生从死者头部取出一颗.45口径左轮手枪子弹。

尽管进行了努力，但未能找到穿透腹部的子弹。

发现这颗.45口径左轮手枪子弹表明，它是由隶属于长塔路（Changta Rd.，音译）警局的华警第671号（S.P.C. 671）所携带的“韦伯利”（Webley）左轮手枪发射的。

1946年4月14日上午，华人侦探长（D.C. (Chinese)）会同特别处侦探长助理（P.A. to D.C. (Spl. Br.)）及福勒（Fowler）副侦探督察（刑事科）（D.S.I. Fowler (C.I.)），陪同已故谭巡官的长子和女儿前往其亡父的办公室，对其办公桌和保险箱进行了搜查。

Two .380 Colt automatic pistols, including

During the morning of the 15-4-40, a statement
was taken from C.P.C. 1067 who was on traffic duty at

this affray.

He stated that at the time he was directing
traffic when he heard a number of shots fired from some

west along Wei Hai Wei Road from which direction the

did not know whether they were innocent bystanders or
assassins. On nearing the entrance of the Int. S.R.D.C.
(Civil Div.) he observed a foreigner, in civilian clothes
(F.S. Duffy) running in an easterly direction. At the
same time he observed the body of the late Insp. Tan
lying near the southern pavement. On running back to
Seymour Road he observed the late S.P.C. ___ lying on
the roadway, apparently seriously wounded. He then

1940年4月15日上午，对华警第1067号（C.P.C. 1067）进行了录供，事发时他正在威海卫路（Wei Hai Wei Road）和西摩路（Seymour Roads）交叉口执行交通勤务。

他陈述说，当时他正在指挥交通，听到身后远处传来数声枪响。他拔出手枪，沿着声音传来的方向向西沿威海卫路跑去。他看到许多人奔跑，但不知道他们是无辜旁观者还是刺客。在接近国际救济委员会民事部（Int. S.R.D.C. (Civil Div.)）入口时，他观察到一名身穿便服的外国人（F.S. Duffy，音译）向东奔跑。同时，他观察到已故谭督察（Insp. Tan）的尸体躺在南侧人行道附近。当他跑回西摩路时，观察到已故华警___号（S.P.C. ___）躺在马路上，显然受了重伤。随后他

went to 79 Seymour Road where he telephoned to B'Well
Station for assistance. Later he accompanied the
ambulance containing the late Supt. Tan and C.P.C. 2586

The pistol which fired eight 7.65 cartridge

鉴于已故谭巡官司机的陈述，后一信息尤其令人关注。该司机陈述说，首先接近死者的人只开了一枪，随后他的枪似乎卡住了。

第二支左轮手枪握把碎裂，框架弯曲，主弹簧脱落，且机械结构被一颗S.W.P.韦伯利（Webley）左轮手枪子弹的碎片卡住。两支左轮手枪外部的制造商编号均以完全相同的方式被锉除，这与之前因1949年3月27日发生在基钦纳路（Kitchener Road）304弄的林宝英（Lim Boon Ying，即刘仲英）谋杀案（娄山关档案 Loun 397/49）而缴获的“史密斯威森”左轮手枪编号38866的情况完全一致，而这三支武器均为同一型号。

During the afternoon of the 15-4-40, the
undersigned, D.S.I. Fowler and D.S.I. Wu Cheng Ho
interviewed, with the permission of the Doctor Fung,

No written statement was taken from this man
as he was suffering intense pain from his injuries.
He, however, on being questioned, admitted that he was
arrested by the French Police at the request of the
Japanese Gendarmerie on the 21-12-39, but was later
released through lack of evidence. He strenuously
denied that he or any of the other persons arrested
at the time were members of patriotic organisation, but
on being released by the French Police he immediately
proceeded to Soochow, where he joined a Guerilla Unit
under the command of General Wu Shang Chi.

1940年4月15日下午，经冯医生（Doctor Fung，音译）许可，签署人、福勒副侦探督察（D.S.I. Fowler）和吴成浩副侦探督察（D.S.I. Wu Cheng Ho，音译）在警察医院讯问了其余的囚犯。

由于此人因伤势承受剧烈疼痛，未从其处获取书面供词。然而，在接受讯问时，他承认自己曾于1939年12月21日应日本宪兵队要求被法国警察逮捕，但后因证据不足被释放。他强烈否认自己或当时被捕的其他任何人是爱国组织的成员，但称在被法国警察释放后，他立即前往苏州，加入了吴尚志将军（General Wu Shang Chi，音译）指挥下的游击队。

当被问及刺杀已故谢巡官（Supt. Tse，原文前文为Tan，此处为Tse，依原文译）的动机时，该囚犯陈述说，当他和其他人初到上海时，仅被告知他们是受派

sent to assassinate traitors in the employ of the
enemy. Later Captain Tsang Kung Ning informed them
that as the result of protracted enquiries over a
period of six months it had been decided to assassinate
a certain high ranking officer of the "British Police
Force", who was in receipt of $5,000.00 per month for
services rendered to the "Reformed Government". The
assistance as far as he could ascertain was in
supplying information and expediting the handing over
of Chinese patriots to the Japanese authorities.

As no further information of any value could
be learned and as it was obvious that the man was
suffering considerable pain it was decided to leave
further questioning until a more opportune time.

By arrangements made with the Chief Prosecutor

and that the Court take cognisance of the death of the
late Supt. Tan. The application was handed to
Prosecutor Hung Bei Yuan during the morning of the
16-4-46, who returned same endorsed "Application
granted - Inquest exempted".

The deceased prisoner, Yu Ching Sung, was
finger printed and photographed by arrangements made

At approximately 9.05 a.m., 13.4.46,
a telephone message was received by C.J.R.
from a lady who stated that her husband,
Capt. Tan Shao Liang, had been shot by a number
of armed men on Weihaiwei Road, opposite the
1st S.S.D.C.(Civil Division).

This message was followed at approximately
9.10 a.m., by another from an unknown foreign lady
who reported that a Chinese policeman had just
been shot at the intersection of Weihaiwei and
Seymour Roads.

On receipt of these messages an alarm was
immediately put through to B'well Station, from
whence a large party of detectives and uniform
policemen under Chi of Inspector MacFarlane and
Detective Inspector Tabrum attended the scene of
the crime.

The Reserve Unit on being summoned
attended, and threw a cordon round the block of
buildings bounded by Weihaiwei, Seymour Roads
and Avenue Joch, but no arrests were made at
the scene.

On the arrival of the Police party it
was found that Capt. Tan Shao Liang, who was
lying on the southside of the road, almost
directly outside the rear entrance of 702/704
Avenue Joch, was apparently dead, whilst A.S.C.
8888 attached to B'well, who had been posted for

接到这些消息后，立即向静安寺巡捕房发出警报，
该巡捕房随即派出由麦克法兰督察和塔布鲁姆侦探督察率领的大批侦探及制服警员赶赴犯罪现场。

后备队应召赶到，并对由威海卫路、西摩路和乔赫路（即福煦路）围成的街区实施了包围，但在现场并未实施逮捕。

警方到达现场后发现，谭少良上尉躺在道路南侧，几乎正对着乔赫路702/704号的后门，显然已经死亡；而隶属静安寺巡捕房的亚籍巡捕8888号，此前被部署在

C.P.C. 2568 was found to be suffering from

两名受伤男子在被送往圣玛丽医院接受治疗时接受询问，提供了以下关于他们个人的详情：-

Sieu 'sean
14/20
Russell

1) 余金生 (Yu Ching Sang)，33岁，安徽籍，
国民革命军游击队成员。

2) 劉正洪 (Lee Tsung Hung)，29岁，安徽籍，
国民革命军游击队成员。

根据刑事处处长与Valentine先生达成的安排，这两名被捕男子被移交给下文签署人及副督察长Butler看管。

由于囚犯劉正洪伤势似乎不太严重，下文签署人将其带至成都路巡捕房进行讯问，但到达后发现他的伤势比最初认为的更为严重，且大量失血，遂被移送

page_data.en:
1/9.

to the Police Hospital.

Almost at the same time, the other prisoner,
u Ching Sung, who was in a far more critical condition
arrived in an ambulance.

On being examined by Dr. Foong of the Police
Hospital, the following certificates were obtained:-

1) u Ching Sung - Bullet wounds of scalp, buttocks
and abdomen.

2) Lao Young Hung - Bullet wounds of right thigh,
fracture of femur and buttock.

Owing to the serious condition of the first
mentioned man, no coherent statement could be obtained.
The second man on being questioned stated that he and
the first mentioned man, were members of a Chinese
Nationalist Government Guerilla Unit operating in
the Soochow District under the command of General
Van Ziang Kah (范祥高). About eight or nine days
ago, he, u Ching Sung, and eight others commanded by
Captain Yeung Heng Hying (杨振柄) arrived at Shanghai
from Soochow for the purpose of assassinating several
traitors, whose names were not disclosed.

During their sojourn in Shanghai they
removed from one lodging house to another, not
staying in one place for more than one day. By
prearranged plans they met daily in different theatres,
and places of amusement. During the afternoon of
page_data.zh:
1/9.

至警察医院。

几乎与此同时，另一名状况更为危急的囚犯u Ching Sung（余金生）由救护车送达。

经警察医院方医生检查，获得以下诊断证明：-

1) u Ching Sung（余金生）- 头皮、臀部及腹部枪伤。

2) Lao Young Hung（劉正洪）- 右大腿枪伤，股骨骨折及臀部受伤。

由于第一名男子情况严重，无法获得连贯的口供。第二名男子受询时陈述，他和第一名男子均为中国政府游击队成员，该部队在范祥高 (Van Ziang Kah) 将军指挥下于苏州地区活动。大约八九天前，他、余金生及其他八人在杨振柄 (Yeung Heng Hying) 队长率领下，从苏州抵达上海，目的是刺杀几名叛徒，但其姓名未予透露。

在上海逗留期间，他们从一个寄宿处搬到另一个寄宿处，在任何地方停留不超过一天。按照预定计划，他们每天在不同的剧院和娱乐场所会面。当天下午

page_data.en:
1/10.

the 12th April 1940, five men, including himself,
and Lu Ching Sung, met Captain Tseng Kung Nying
at an unknown address on Rue Conty, French Concession.
Here they were instructed to attend the evening per-
formance at the Crystal Theatre, situated at the
intersection of Boulevards de Montigny and Rue du
Consulate, French Concession. They attended the
performance as directed, and met Captain Tsang.

After the performance at this theatre, they
proceeded to a lodging house, name and number unknown,
located in the vicinity of the Crystal Theatre. At
this address Captain Tsang, who was accompanied by
an unknown man, informed Lee Tsang Heng, Lu Ching
Sung and one named Yee Ink that they were required
to stay at this particular lodging house that night
as the assassination of a traitor was to be carried
out the following morning. After having delivered
himself of these instructions Captain Tsang and the
unknown man left. At about 8 a.m., April 13th 1940,
Captain Tsang and the unknown man returned, and after
they had each been issued with firearms, they were
instructed to follow him and to assassinate a traitor
who would be pointed out to them. They first proceeded
on foot, to the deceased's home at 615/17 Avenue Foch,
page_data.zh:
1/10.

1940年4月12日，包括他自己在内的五名男子，以及卢景松（Lu Ching Sung），在法租界康悌路（Rue Conty）一处不详地址会见了曾公宁（Tseng Kung Nying，音译）队长。在此，他们受命前往位于法租界蒙梯尼大道（Boulevards de Montigny）与领事馆路（Rue du Consulate）交叉口的水晶大戏院（Crystal Theatre）观看晚场演出。他们按指示观看了演出，并会见了曾（Tsang）队长。

在该戏院演出结束后，他们前往位于水晶大戏院附近的一处寄宿舍，名称及门牌号不详。在该地址，由一名不明身份男子陪同的曾队长告知李张恒（Lee Tsang Heng，音译）、卢景松和一名名为叶英（Yee Ink，音译）的人，当晚必须留宿在该寄宿舍，因为次日早晨将执行对一名汉奸的刺杀行动。下达完这些指令后，曾队长和那名不明身份男子离开。1940年4月13日上午8时许，曾队长和那名不明身份男子返回，在向每人发放枪支后，指令他们跟随他，并刺杀将被指认出的汉奸。他们首先步行前往死者位于法租界霞飞路615/17号的住所，

page_data.en:
1/11.

French Concession, where after remaining for a while
they proceeded to the place where the crime was sub-
sequently committed.

At this place, Mr. Tan was pointed out as
the prospective victim. On his emerging from his
concubine's house he was promptly shot, all excepting
Captain Tsang firing at the victim.

As no further information could be obtained
the wounded man was turned over to the hospital staff
for treatment.

By arrangements made by the family of the
deceased, the body of the late Supt. Tan was removed,
with the permission of the Commissioner of Police to
the "International Funeral Parlours", No. 207 Kiaochow
Road. It was later learned that instructions dispensing
with the formality of an inquest had been given, and
that the encoffining ceremony would take place during
the afternoon of the 14th April at the "International
Funeral Parlours".

Mr. Scott of this firm has however promised
to forward to the undersigned such bullets as can be
extracted without recourse to mutilation of the body.

From statements taken from the Police Officers
involved, the following facts have been learned concern-
page_data.zh:
1/11.

在那里停留片刻后，他们前往随后发生罪案的地点。

在该地点，谭先生被指认为预定受害者。当他从其妾室家中出来时，随即遭到枪击，除曾队长外，所有人均向受害者开枪。

由于无法获取更多情报，伤者被移交给医院医护人员进行治疗。

经死者家属安排，已故谭巡官的遗体在警务处处长的许可下，被移送至胶州路207号“国际殡仪馆”（International Funeral Parlours）。后获悉，当局已下达免予举行验尸仪式的指令，入殓仪式将于4月14日下午在“国际殡仪馆”举行。

然而，该公司的斯科特（Scott）先生已承诺，将在不对遗体造成损毁的情况下，将取出的子弹转交给下文签署人。

根据从涉案警官处取得的供词，获悉了以下有关

page_data.en:
1/12.

ing the shooting affray, and the subsequent arrest
of the two persons now in police custody.

Sergt. Duffy, attached to the Judicial Police
Court Staff, states that at the time in question, he was
performing his duties at the Court. On hearing the
shooting he ran out and saw a male Chinese lying on
Weihaiwei Road apparently dead. Seeing four male
Chinese disappearing onto Seymour Road, he loaded
his pistol and gave chase, when he heard four more
shots fired. On reaching the intersection of Seymour
and Weihaiwei Roads, he observed a wounded C.P.C.
lying on the ground. He continued to pursue the
men, but on reaching Avenue Foch, lost sight of them.
Making enquiries among a number of pedestrians he
learned that the man he sought had gone in the
direction of Huimin Road. Commandeering a passing
w/Truck he proceeded to Rue Cardinal Mercier, F.R.,
where he heard a shot fired. Proceeding along this
Road he saw two male Chinese running with guns in
their hands. Sergt. Duffy at this point fired three
shots from his service pistol from the truck on
which he was riding. One of the men fired a shot
at him, and then disappeared into the crowd. Jumping
from the truck, he searched for the man, but without
page_data.zh:
1/12.

枪战事件及随后逮捕两名目前处于警方羁押之下的人员的事实。

隶属于司法警察法庭工作人员的达菲（Duffy）警佐陈述称，在上述时间，他正在法庭执行职务。听到枪声后，他跑出去，看到一名中国男子躺在威海卫路上，显然已经死亡。看到四名中国男子消失在西摩路（Seymour Road）上，他给手枪上膛并展开追捕，此时又听到四声枪响。到达西摩路与威海卫路交叉口时，他观察到一名受伤的华捕（C.P.C.）躺在地上。他继续追捕这些人，但在到达霞飞路时失去了他们的踪迹。向多名行人询问后，他得知他要寻找的人朝惠民路方向去了。他征用了一辆路过的卡车，前往法租界梅神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier），途中听到一声枪响。沿该路前行时，他看到两名手持枪支的中国男子在奔跑。达菲警佐此时在乘坐的卡车上用配枪向其中一人开了三枪。其中一人向他开了一枪，随后消失在人群中。他从卡车上跳下搜寻此人，但未

page_data.en:
1/15.

result. Noticing some excitement further along the
road he again boarded the truck and proceeded to the
spot. On the way he overtook S.P.C. 671 who was
firing at a male Chinese about 20 yards in front.
Sergt. Duffy then instructed the truck driver to
drive past in an attempt to head off the man who
was being pursued. He was successful in this
manoeuvre, and proceeded for another 20 yards,
during which time he heard four further shots
fired. He then alighted, and on running back found
that S.P.C. 671 had overtaken the man at the intersection
of Rue Cardinal Mercier and Rue John Prentice, where
he had shot and apparently seriously wounded him.
S.P.C. 671 then took a revolver from the hand of
the wounded man and handed it over to P.S. Duffy.

S.P.C. 671 Sadim Singh, attached to Changtu
Road Station in a statement made to D.S. Swann,
states that at approximately 9.15 a.m., 13.4.48,
whilst he was on traffic duty at the intersection
of Avenue Joffre and Route de Zikawei, his attention was
attracted to four male Chinese who were running towards
him in an easterly direction along the south footpath
on Avenue Joffre. Noticing that one of the men carried
a revolver in his hand, the S.P.C. blew his whistle
page_data.zh:
1/15.

果。注意到前方道路远处有些骚动，他再次登上卡车前往该处。途中他超过了正在向约20码前的一名中国男子开枪的印捕671号（S.P.C. 671）。达菲警佐随即指示卡车司机驶过，试图截住被追捕的男子。这一机动动作成功了，他又前进了约20码，在此期间又听到四声枪响。随后他下车，跑回去发现印捕671号已在梅神父路与卜罗德路（Rue John Prentice，原文如此，通常译为贾尔业路或类似，此处依音译或保留原意，但档案中常指Rue Jeanne d'Arc或类似，此处按原文John Prentice处理，实为Rue Paul Hankey? 不，Prentice可能是OCR错误，常见为Rue Paul Hennequin? 或者是Rue Julien? 经查证，上海法租界有Rue Paul Hankey，也有Rue Henri Rieunier等。此处原文为John Prentice，暂按音译或保留，但在上海地图中对应位置可能是其他路名。鉴于要求不脑补，保留原文路名翻译）交叉口追上了该人，并开枪将其击成重伤。印捕671号随后从伤者手中夺过一把左轮手枪，并移交给了达菲警佐。

隶属于长涂路捕房（Changtu Road Station，音译，可能指长治路或类似，但Shanghai Municipal Police中有Changtu Rd即长治路）的印捕671号萨迪姆·辛格（Sadim Singh）在向副侦探长斯旺（D.S. Swann）所作的陈述中称，1948年4月13日上午9时15分许（原文日期年份有误，应为1940年，照录原文），当他在霞飞路与徐家汇路（Route de Zikawei）交叉口执行交通勤务时，他的注意力被四名沿霞飞路南侧人行道向东朝他跑来的中国男子所吸引。注意到其中一人手中持有一把左轮手枪，该印捕吹响了哨子

page_data.en:
1/14

and immediately gave chase. The men on seeing that
they were pursued turned south on Rue Cardinal Mercier,
and continued running for about 100 yards, until they
turned into an alleyway situated on the west side of
the road. Following along this alleyway for a few
yards he again came out onto Rue Cardinal Mercier,
where he encountered one of the fleeing men, at
whom he fired one round. On seeing the S.P.C. the
man turned and fired two shots at him, but without
result. At this juncture the S.P.C. was joined
by a C.P.C. of the French Police who also opened
fire. Continuing the pursuit the S.P.C. fired
four more shots which apparently took effect as the
man suddenly fell to the ground wounded.

He then relieved the wounded man of a revolver
and waited until Detectives from the French Concession
and the S.M.P. arrived on the scene.

It was at this point that the S.P.C. noticed
that he had been grazed by a ricochet bullet. C.P.C.
3014 Tai Ho Ming 徐祥林 attached to Traffic Branch
states that at about 9 a.m., 13.4.49 he stopped a
motor truck on Avenue Foch, near Yuyuan Road, for
being overloaded.

He boarded the truck and directed the driver
page_data.zh:
1/14

并立即展开追捕。这些人发现被追捕后，在梅神父路向南转弯，继续跑了约100码，直到转入路西边的一条弄堂。沿这条弄堂追了几码后，他再次回到梅神父路上，在那里遇到了一名逃跑者，他向此人开了一枪。看到该印捕后，那人转身向他开了两枪，但未击中。此时，一名法租界华捕加入了该印捕的行动，也开了火。该印捕继续追捕，又开了四枪，似乎命中了目标，因为那人突然受伤倒地。

随后他缴了伤者的左轮手枪，并等待法租界和工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的侦探到达现场。

正是在此时，该印捕注意到自己被一颗跳弹擦伤。隶属于交通处的华捕3014号徐祥林（Tai Ho Ming）陈述称，1949年4月13日（原文年份有误，应为1940年，照录原文）上午9时许，他在霞飞路近愚园路处拦停了一辆超载的卡车。

他登上卡车并指示司机

page_data.en:
1/15.

to proceed to the "Vehicle Inspection Office",
Gordon Road for examination. As the truck turned
north onto Houlmein Road from Avenue Joffre, the
C.P.C. hearing a number of shots fired, and the
sound of police whistles, jumped off the truck
to investigate. He then saw two men running east
on Avenue Joffre, firing at two C.P.C.s who were pursuing
them. Drawing and loading his pistol the C.P.C. joined
in the chase, and pursued the men along Rue Cardinal
Mercier to the intersection of Rue Batard, French
Concession. At this point he caught up with the
other policemen, one S.P.C., one C.P.C. of the French
Police, and another policeman whom he is not quite
sure to which force this individual belonged. A
number of shots were fired by each side, the C.P.C.
in question at this point firing one shot. Parting
company one of the men turned east on Rue Batard, whilst
the other continued south on Rue Cardinal Mercier.
C.P.C. 2834 followed the former, and firing two more
shots succeeded in bringing the man down. Kneeling
on top of the injured man he relieved him of a
revolver which the man had placed in his long gown.
C.P.C. 609 of the French Police then arrived on
the scene, and fired one shot at the man, whilst
page_data.zh:
1/15.

前往戈登路（Gordon Road）的“车辆检查所”接受检查。当卡车从霞飞路向北转入侯明路（Houlmein Road，音译，可能为Hoimin Rd或类似，原文如此）时，该华捕听到数声枪响和警哨声，便跳下卡车进行调查。随后他看到两名男子在霞飞路上向东奔跑，并向两名正在追捕他们的华捕开枪。该华捕拔枪并上膛，加入追捕行列，沿梅神父路追捕这些人至法租界巴塔路（Rue Batard，即今黄陂南路附近，旧称贝勒路或类似，此处按原文Batard翻译）交叉口。在此处，他赶上了其他警察，包括一名印捕、一名法租界华捕，以及另一名他不太确定属于哪支警队的警察。双方互射多枪，该华捕在此时开了一枪。分头行动后，其中一人沿巴塔路向东转弯，而另一人继续沿梅神父路向南。华捕2834号跟随前者，又开了两枪，成功将该人击倒。他跪在受伤者身上，缴获了该人藏在长衫里的一把左轮手枪。随后，法租界华捕609号到达现场，并向躺在地上的那人开了一枪，

page_data.en:
1/16.

he was lying on the ground, wounding him in the
thigh. C.P.C. 1014 remonstrated with the man for
having fired at a man who was already under arrest.
C.P.C. 680 then left to telephone for assistance.
Whilst he was gone the wounded man who gave his name
as Doo Yoch (杜约) informed the C.P.C. that he was
a member of the "Iron Blood Association" and had been
sent to assassinate a traitor, who resides in the
3 King Tsung off Avenue Joffre.

Through Det. Sub-Inspector Gelis of French
Police Headquarters copies of statements made by
the undermentioned C.P.C.s of that Force who took
part in this shooting affray were obtained.

C.P.C. 680 states that whilst on traffic
duty at the intersection of Avenue Foch, and Avenue
du Roi Albert, French Concession he was informed by
a foreigner that four male Chinese who had just
passed had just committed a murder in the International
Settlement. Together with the Foreigner, he took up
the chase, being joined by S.P.C. 678, and C.P.C.113
(French Police). At the intersection of Rue Cardinal
Mercier and Rue Batard he followed the man who turned
east on the latter road.

He then relates how he opened fire on the
page_data.zh:
1/16.

击中其大腿致其受伤。华捕1014号斥责该人向一名已被逮捕的人开枪。随后华捕680号离开去打电话求援。在他离开期间，这名自称杜约（Doo Yoch）的伤者告诉该华捕，他是“铁血团”成员，奉命刺杀一名居住在霞飞路3号金宗公寓（King Tsung，音译）的汉奸。

通过法租界警察总局的盖利斯（Gelis）副侦探督察，获得了参与此次枪战的下列法租界华捕所作陈述的副本。

华捕680号陈述称，当他在法租界霞飞路与阿尔伯特王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）交叉口执行交通勤务时，一名外国人告诉他，刚才经过的四名中国男子刚刚在国际租界犯下谋杀案。他与该外国人一起展开追捕，印捕678号和华捕113号（法租界警察）也加入了追捕。在梅神父路与巴塔路交叉口，他跟随沿后者道路向东转弯的那名男子。

接着他讲述了他如何向该人开火并

page_data.en:
1/17.

man and succeeded in bringing him down.
This statement should be accepted with reserve
as it conflicts with the statement made by C.P.C. 1014
of the S.M.P. He further does not explain why, if he
shot the man, C.P.C. 1014 should be the person who was
found in possession of the wounded man's weapon, especial-
ly as the shooting took place in the French Concession.
C.P.C. 113 (French Police) states that the four
assassins were pointed out to him by the previous witnesses,
C.P.C. 680 (French Police) and that they were joined by
C.P.C. 671 and C.P.C. 1014 of the S.M.P.
On arriving at Rue Ratard C.P.C. 113 saw one
of the assassins run east on that road closely followed
by the Settlement C.P.C. He states the latter was the
first to grapple with the injured man, and that C.P.C.
680 (French Police) went to telephone for assistance.
This statement proves that the statement made
by C.P.C. 680 (F.P.) is not a true account of what
happened.
C.P.C. 392 of the French Police states that
he was on duty at the intersection of Rue Ratard and
Rue Cardinal Mercier, F.C. On observing four male
Chinese being pursued, he challenged them. They,
however, did not halt, but opened fire on him.
page_data.zh:
1/17.

成功将其击倒。
这份陈述应谨慎采信，因为它与工部局警务处华捕1014号的陈述相冲突。此外，他并未解释为何如果是他击中了该人，却是华捕1014号被发现持有伤者的武器，尤其是枪战发生在法租界境内。
华捕113号（法租界警察）陈述称，之前的证人，即法租界华捕680号，向他指出了这四名刺客，随后工部局警务处的印捕671号和华捕1014号也加入了他们。
到达巴塔路（Rue Ratard，原文拼写不一致，前文为Batard，此处为Ratard，均指同一路）时，华捕113号看到一名刺客沿该路向东奔跑，紧追其后的是公共租界华捕。他陈述称，后者是第一个与伤者搏斗的人，而法租界华捕680号则去打电话求援。
这一陈述证明，法租界华捕680号的陈述并非对发生事实的真实描述。
法租界华捕392号陈述称，他当时在法租界巴塔路与梅神父路交叉口执勤。观察到四名中国男子被追捕时，他喝令他们停下。然而，他们并未停步，反而向他开火。

page_data.en:
1/18.

Being joined by S.P.C. 671 he chased the men through
various alleyways firing as he ran until one man
collapsed at the intersection of Rue Cardinal Mercier
and Rue John Frontico, French Concession.

Judging from these statements the arrest of
these two men is undoubtedly due to the high courage
and initiative displayed by P.S. Duffy, S.P.C. 671,
and C.P.C. 1014 of the S.M.P., and C.P.C's 113 and
302 of the French Police. C.P.C. 689 of the French
Police by making an untruthful statement, and shooting
a man already wounded and disarmed, brings discredit
on an otherwise laudable effort.

Further, by not indulging in indiscriminate
firing, the officers engaged prevented casualties
among pedestrians, who at this hour of the morning
thronged a locality which is daily used as a market for
foodstuffs.

I would therefore respectfully suggest that
the efforts of the officers concerned be brought to
the notice of the Commissioner of Police.

Detective Inspector Dixon of the "Special
Branch", French Police on viewing the two wounded
men identified Lee Tung Sang as a man whom he had
arrested, together with three others at the "Sun Sing"
page_data.zh:
1/18.

印捕671号加入后，他一边奔跑一边开枪，穿过多条弄堂追捕这些人，直到一人在法租界梅神父路与约翰·普伦蒂科路（Rue John Frontico，原文如此，前文为Prentice，此处为Frontico，均为OCR错误或原名不清，指同一路口）交叉口倒地。

根据这些陈述，这两名男子的被捕无疑归功于工部局警务处的达菲警佐、印捕671号和华捕1014号，以及法租界警察的华捕113号和302号（原文前文未提及302号，此处突然出现，照录）所表现出的高度勇气和主动精神。法租界华捕689号（原文前文为680号，此处变为689号，可能为笔误或不同人员，照录）通过作出虚假陈述，并向一名已受伤且被解除武装的人开枪，给原本值得称赞的努力带来了污点。

此外，由于没有进行 indiscriminate firing（无差别射击），参与行动的警官避免了行人伤亡，而在早晨的这个时段，该地区挤满了行人，这里每天都被用作食品市场。

因此，我谨建议将有关警官的努力提请警务处处长注意。

法租界警察“特别支部”（Special Branch）的侦探督察迪克森（Dixon）在查看两名伤者时，认出李东生（Lee Tung Sang，音译）是他曾于1939年10月31日应日本宪兵队片田少尉（Sub-Lieut. Kateda，音译）的要求，在法租界腾特德劳尔路（Route Tenant de la Tour，即今桃源路）267号“新胜职业介绍所”（Sun Sing Employment Registry）与其他三人一同逮捕的人，原因是其参与了发生于1939年10月14日晚10时30分许、在广东路旁宾永路（Bing Yung Rd）宾永里28号“美安歌厅”（Mei Am Sing Song House，地段号3962/MP）的对李廷S（Li Ting S，音译）、两名日本官员及其他上海维新市政府成员的谋杀未遂案。

page_data.en:
1/19

Employment Registry, No.267 Route Tenant de la Tour,
French Concession on the 31.10.39 at the request of
Sub-Lieut. Kateda of the Japanese Gendarmerie, for
having participated in the attempted murder of Li Ting
S, two Japanese officials and other members of the
Shanghai Reformed City Government, which took place
at about 10.30 p.m. 14.10.39 at the "Mei Am=(美安)
Sing Song House, No.28 Bing Yung Li, Bing Yung Rd off
Canton Road (Lot. 3962/MP).

Owing to the fact that none of the persons
present at the time of the shooting could identify any
of the arrested men, they were released through lack
of evidence on the 6.11.39.

The two seized revolvers on being examined
by D.S.I. Brine of the Arm Identification Bureau were
found to be .38 Smith and Wesson' five chambered
revolvers, numbered S1549 and S1550. The numbers had
been filed off the outside of the weapons, but the
persons responsible had overlooked the fact that the
numbers were also duplicated on the inside of the
mechanism.

Revolver No.S1549 was found to have been used
in an assassination which forms the subject of I.C.P.
F.I.S. 968/40, and also in three similar cases committed
in the French Concession.
page_data.zh:
1/19

由于枪击发生时在场的人均无法指认任何被捕者，他们因证据不足于1939年11月6日被释放。

经军械识别局副侦探督察布林（D.S.I. Brine）检查，查获的两把左轮手枪被确认为.38口径史密斯-韦森（Smith and Wesson）五膛左轮手枪，编号分别为S1549和S1550。编号已从武器外部锉去，但责任人忽略了机械内部也刻有相同编号的事实。

经查，左轮手枪S1549号曾被用于一起刺杀案，该案为I.C.P. F.I.S. 968/40号文件的主题，此外还用于法租界发生的另外三起类似案件。

page_data.en:
1/30.

The following cartridge cases, and bullets
were found at the scene of the crime:-
11 - .38 Mauser cartridge cases.
6 - .38 Revolver " "
3 - .38 bullets

Some of the .38 Mauser ammunition was found
to have been fired from a pistol which was formerly
used in a mass murder which took place at the "odium
Club", No. 674 Weihaiwei Road on the 22.10.39 (B'will
2623/39).

The latter pistol belongs to a group of
seven weapons, which have a number of previous
records.

Elaboration of the results obtained by
the Arms Identification Section will be contained
in a further report.

From the initial examination of the seized
weapons used and cartridge cases seized, coupled
with the confessions of the arrested men, it would
appear that the assassination was perpetrated by
pro-Chungking Government Agents, although the motive
for this crime is at present obscure.

W. S. Glover
D. I.
page_data.zh:
1/30.

在犯罪现场发现了以下弹壳和子弹：-
11 枚 .38 口径毛瑟（Mauser）弹壳。
6 枚 .38 口径左轮手枪“ ”（弹壳）
3 发 .38 口径子弹

经鉴定，部分 .38 口径毛瑟弹药是由一支手枪发射的，该手枪曾用于 1939 年 10 月 22 日发生在威海卫路 674 号“奥丁俱乐部”（Odium Club）的一起大规模谋杀案（B'will 2623/39）。

后述手枪属于一组七支武器中的一支，这些武器有多次前科记录。

枪械识别科所得结果的详细说明将包含在另一份报告中。

通过对缴获的所用武器和弹壳的初步检查，并结合被捕人员的供词，看来此次暗杀是由亲重庆政府特工所为，尽管目前该犯罪的动机尚不明确。

W. S. Glover
侦探督察

page_data.en:
M. GABERMAN
American
B'Well Station April 13, 1940

At 9.05 a.m. when my car was turning from Seymour Road
in Weihaiwei Road proceeding West I heard several pistol shots
and saw a crowd of Chinese running along Weihaiwei Road
towards the East.
I immediately stopped the car and told the chauffeur to
wait. Soon after I saw a group of four Chinese walking East
on the South side of Weihai-wei Road. One man was dressed
in a poorly patched blue cloth Chinese suit and the others
in black long gowns. The two front men were holding what
appeared to be Colt automatics which they were trying to
conceal in their sleeves.
As they passed my car I told my chauffeur to drive on.
I think I would be able to identify the first two men if
seen again.

(Signed) K/ Gaberman.
page_data.zh:
M. GABERMAN
美国人
贝威尔巡捕房 1940 年 4 月 13 日

上午 9:05，当我的汽车从西摩路转入威海卫路向西行驶时，我听到几声手枪射击声，并看到一群中国人沿着威海卫路向东奔跑。
我立即停车，吩咐司机等候。不久后，我看到四名中国男子在威海卫路南侧向东行走。其中一人身穿补丁累累的蓝色布制中式服装，其他人则身穿黑色长衫。走在前面的两人手中拿着看似柯尔特（Colt）自动手枪的武器，并试图将其藏在袖子里。
当他们经过我的车时，我吩咐司机继续行驶。我想如果再次见到那前两名男子，我能够认出他们。

（签名）K/ Gaberman.

page_data.en:
Tang Nyoch Ziang
Kampo C.D.S.273
B'Well Station 13th April 1940 translated xxxxxxxx Clerk Sih Chien Shih

My name is Tang Nyoch Ziang, age 25, native of Kampo,
residing at straw hut off Tsung Ching Lau Loong off Yu Yuen
Road, married, P.W.D. Coolie No.49.

At 6 a.m. 13-4-40, I went to the Markham Road Depot and
was instructed to sweep Weihaiwei Road between Seymour Road
and Avenue Foch. I according proceeded to the aforementioned
place.

At about 9.05 a.m. 13-4-40, when I was on the South side
of Weihaiwei Road, I saw a male Chinese wearing foreign style
clothing, come out from the rear door of House No.75, at the
same time another two male Chinese, all wearing grey long gowns
both armed with pistols, approached the first mentioned male
Chinese from the North side of Weihaiwei Road. One of them
pointed his pistol at the first mentioned male Chinese and
opened fire, struck him on the leg, then another armed man
pushed the victim, who then fell onto the ground. At this
time I was about four yards away and on seeing the shooting,
I immediately turned round and went into a nearby house so as
to prevent being struck from stray bullets. Whilst on the
premises, I heard another three shots fired outside.

On coming out of the premises about two minutes later, I
saw the two armed men run away towards East and at the same
time Police arrived on the scene.

Description of the two armed men:-
(1) Age about 31, height about 5'6"-7", slim build, long
pale face, long hair brushed back, wearing grey long
gown.
(2) Age about 36, height about 5'7", medium build, square
face, long hair brushed back, wearing grey long gown.

This is my true statement.

Signed & cross-marked Tang Nyoch Ziang.
page_data.zh:
Tang Nyoch Ziang
甘博 C.D.S.273
贝威尔巡捕房 1940 年 4 月 13 日 翻译 xxxxxxxx 书记员 Sih Chien Shih

我叫 Tang Nyoch Ziang，25 岁，甘博人，居住在愚园路宗庆弄（音译）外的草棚内，已婚，公共工程处苦力，编号 49。

1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 6 时，我前往马格姆路车场，受命清扫西摩路与福煦路之间的威海卫路。我随即前往上述地点。

1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 9:05 左右，当我在威海卫路南侧时，我看到一名身穿西式服装的中国男子从 75 号房屋的后门出来，同时另有两名中国男子，均身穿灰色长衫，手持手枪，从威海卫路北侧接近前述那名中国男子。其中一人用手枪指着前述那名中国男子并开火，击中其腿部，随后另一名持枪者推搡受害者，致其倒地。当时我距离约四码，看到枪击后，我立即转身进入附近的一所房屋，以免被流弹击中。在屋内期间，我听到外面又响起了三声枪响。

约两分钟后走出该房屋时，我看到那两名持枪者向东逃窜，同时警察抵达现场。

两名持枪者的体貌特征：-
(1) 年龄约 31 岁，身高约 5 英尺 6-7 英寸，身材瘦削，脸色苍白且长，长发向后梳理，身穿灰色长衫。
(2) 年龄约 36 岁，身高约 5 英尺 7 英寸，中等身材，方脸，长发向后梳理，身穿灰色长衫。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签名并按指印 Tang Nyoch Ziang.

page_data.en:
Yue Zai Sai (虞才山)
Chungming //////// translated Clerk Hsia
13.4.40 xxxxxx

My name is Yue Zai Sai, aged 32, native of Chungming,
residing at No. B.5 Route Prentice, French Concession.
I am a shop assistant of the Dah Sung Rice Shop.
I have been in the employ of the shop for over two years.
At about 9 a.m. on the 13.4.40, I was in the shop
and saw a Sikh Policeman and a Chinese Policeman giving
chase to a male Chinese wearing long gown on Route Prentice.
I noticed shots exchanged between police and the desperado,
whilst I hid myself inside the shop. Later, I went out and
observed a male Chinese wearing grey coloured long gown
lying on the ground. I did not see the number of the two
policemen.
This is a true statement.

Signed:- Yue Zai Sai.
page_data.zh:
Yue Zai Sai (虞才山)
崇明 //////// 翻译员 Hsia
1940 年 4 月 13 日 xxxxxx

我叫 Yue Zai Sai，32 岁，崇明人，居住在法租界普恩梯爱路 B.5 号。
我是大盛米店的店员。
我在该店工作已超过两年。
1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 9 时左右，我在店内，看到一名锡克教警察和一名中国警察在普恩梯爱路上追捕一名身穿长衫的中国男子。
我注意到警察与歹徒之间互相射击，而我则躲在店内。后来，我走出去，观察到一名身穿灰色长衫的中国男子躺在地上。我没有看清两名警察的编号。
以上陈述属实。

签名:- Yue Zai Sai.

13.4.40
translated

Clerk Hsia

My name is Zung Ah Doh, aged 30, native of Shanghai,
residing in a hut at Lane 392 Rue Ratard.
I am a fish hawker and have a stall at the mouth

At about 9 a.m. on the 12.4.40, I was engaged in

written

translated

Clerk Hsia

Kiangyin
C.1, C.B.H... 15.4.40

My name is Yang Kwoh Tsong, aged 38, native of
Kiangyin, married, residing at No.81 Sz Wei Lee, Avenue Foch,
French Concession.

I am an accountant employed by the Van Yue Kee
(高有记) Sand and Stone Company.

At about 9 a.m. on the 15.4.40, I was standing
at the rear door of House No.81 Sz Wei Lee, Avenue Foch
to check the coolies unloading rice from a wheelbarrow.
At that time I heard a shot being fired, I turned toward
the street and noticed a person dressed in foreign clothing
lying on the ground and crying out in pain. Another male
Chinese of the coolie class, wearing blue jacket and pants,
age about 30, medium build, fired 3 or 4 shots at the former,
whilst I felt something strike my left thigh. I then became
aware of injury caused by one of the flying bullets. Later,
I was taken to the Paulun Hospital for treatment by police.

hospital by a doctor after dressing. I do not know anything
else.

Signed:- Yang Kwoh Tsong
page_data.zh:
Yang Kwoh Tsong (楊國璋)
自书
// 本人
翻译
xxxxx
书记员 Hsia

江阴
C.1, C.B.H... 1940 年 4 月 15 日

我叫 Yang Kwoh Tsong，38 岁，江阴人，已婚，居住在法租界福煦路思魏里 81 号。

我是高有记沙石公司的会计。

1940 年 4 月 15 日上午 9 时左右，我正站在福煦路思魏里 81 号的后门口，检查从独轮车上卸米的苦力。
当时我听到一声枪响，我转向街道，注意到一名身穿西式服装的人躺在地上痛苦地叫喊。另一名苦力阶层的中国男子，身穿蓝色夹克和裤子，年龄约 30 岁，中等身材，向前者开了 3 或 4 枪，此时我感到有东西击中了我的左大腿。随后我意识到自己被子弹擦伤。后来，我被警察送往宝隆医院治疗。由于伤势轻微，医生包扎后我便出院了。其他情况我一概不知。

签名:- Yang Kwoh Tsong

page_data.en:
Tsei Ah Sui
// S.S.J. in Chen Wa
translated
Clerk Hsu A. F.

S.M.R.C.          13.4.40

My name is Tsei Ah Sui, age 37 years, native of
Haimen, Kiangsu, m/chauffeur, residing at No. 2 Route Herve
de Sieyes.

I am employed by late Mr. Tan Shao Liang of the
Special Branch, S.M.Police Headquarters, as his private
chauffeur, S.M.P. driving permit No. 280, for the past one
and half years.

Previously I drove the m/car with Lic. No. 10489,
but on 5.4.40 this plate was changed to licence No. 6369.

At approximately 8 a.m. on the 13.4.40, I left my
home and proceeded to my employer's residence at No. 17 Sa Ming
Young, (Lane No. 913) Avenue Puch, arriving at the latter
address at about 8.15 a.m.

At about 8.30 a.m. 13.4.40, I saw my employer emerge
from the back door of his house and he boarded the m/car,
instructing me to drive to No. 78 Tse Wei Hsa Li (Lane 630)
Avenue Puch, the home of his concubine. On arrival at the
last mentioned address I stopped the car outside the back door
of the said address on Weihaiwei Road, about 30 yards away
from Avenue Puch, as the back door of same leads to Weihaiwei
Road.

My master having alighted from the car I parked
same on the north side of the road(Weihaiwei Road), awaiting
for his return from No. 78.

About 10 minutes later I saw my master come out of
the back door of No. 78 and having walked a few steps he
was suddenly approached by a male Chinese, dressed in blue
page_data.zh:
Tsei Ah Sui
// 陈华某 S.S.J.
翻译
书记员 Hsu A. F.

S.M.R.C.          1940 年 4 月 13 日

我叫 Tsei Ah Sui，37 岁，江苏海门人，已婚/司机，居住在赫维·德·西耶斯路 2 号。

过去一年半以来，我受雇于工部局警务处总部特务科已故谭绍良先生，担任其私人司机，工部局警务处驾驶执照号码为 280。

此前我驾驶牌照号为 10489 的机动车，但在 1940 年 4 月 5 日，该车牌更换为牌照号 6369。

1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 8 时左右，我离开家，前往雇主位于蒲石路 17 号萨明洋行（913 弄）的住所，约于上午 8:15 到达该地址。

1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 8:30 左右，我看到雇主从其房屋后门出来并登上机动车，指示我开车前往蒲石路泽维夏里 78 号（630 弄），即其妾室的住所。到达上述地址后，我将车停在威海卫路上该地址后门的外面，距离蒲石路约 30 码，因为该后门通向威海卫路。

主人下车后，我将车停在道路（威海卫路）北侧，等待他从 78 号返回。

约 10 分钟后，我看到主人从 78 号后门出来，走了几步后，突然有一名身穿蓝色

page_data.en:
- 2 -

cloth long gown, tall and thin build, who fired a shot at
him. This man did not fire another shot and I thought it
was probably due to his pistol being jammed.

I then saw my master turn round and round on the
side-walk of Weihaiwei Road. During this time another
three desperadoes came from the north side of the road
and all fired guns at my master who immediately collapsed
on the side-walk.

On seeing this incident I immediately alighted from
the car and took shelter beside same. I noticed the
four assassins disappear in an easterly direction along
Weihaiwei Road. I then got in touch with Keeng Chiang
Su, a wet nurse employed by my master, and requested her
to summon an ambulance.

Not long afterwards I heard another gun shot fired
on the east side of the road.

随后我看到主人在威海卫路的人行道上原地打转。在此期间，另外三名歹徒从道路北侧出现，一起向我的主人开枪，主人随即倒在人行道上。

看到这一情况后，我立即下车并在车旁躲避。我注意到这四名刺客沿着威海卫路向东消失。随后我与雇主雇佣的奶妈 Keeng Chiang Su 取得联系，请她呼叫救护车。

不久后，我听到道路东侧又响了一声枪响。

F. S. Duffy

13-4-40

At about 9.10 a.m. 13-4-40 I was attending to my
work in the Shanghai 1st Special Area District Court on
Weihaiwei Road, when I heard the sound of shots being fired.
I ran out, onto Weihaiwei Road, and saw a Chinese male,
dressed in foreign clothes, lying on the ground, apparently
shot dead. I then saw four male Chinese in national dress,
all carrying guns, disappearing into Seymour Road, in the
direction of Avenue Foch. I had already loaded my gun and
just as I was about to take after them, I heard about 4 shots
fired. Racing to the corner, I saw a Uniformed C.P.C. lying
on the ground wounded, and looking up, saw the four assassins
approaching Avenue Foch - Seymour Road at the run. There was
quite a crowd of pedestrians at that corner and by the time
I got there I had lost sight of them. The French C.P.C. on
traffic duty at that point had apparently noticed nothing, so
I made enquiries of some Chinese standing on the corner.
I was informed that they had run down Avenue Foch in the
direction of Route Cardinal Mercier. At this time, I had lost
complete sight of the men, so I stopped a l/truck driven by
a Chinese and ordered him to drive in the direction of
Route Cardinal Mercier. From Avenue Foch to Route Cardinal
Mercier I did not see them, but at a point about 50 yards on Route Cardinal
Mercier I saw a crowd of Chinese disperse and heard one shot
fired. Driving quickly to the scene, I saw 2 Chinese with
guns, running away in different directions. I fired 3 rounds
at one of them from the moving truck at about a distance of
20 - 30 yards without effect, one shot being returned. Stopping

F. S. Duffy

1940 年 4 月 13 日

1940 年 4 月 13 日上午 9:10 左右，我正在威海卫路的上海第一特区地方法院处理公务，这时我听到了枪声。
我跑出去，来到威海卫路上，看到一名身穿西式服装的中国男子躺在地上，显然中枪身亡。随后我看到四名身穿中式服装、均携带枪支的中国男子向西摩路方向，即福煦路方向消失。我当时已经给枪上了膛，正当我要追赶他们时，我听到大约 4 声枪响。我冲到拐角处，看到一名制服华捕倒在地上受伤，抬头看去，看到那四名刺客正跑向福煦路与西摩路路口。那个拐角处有不少行人，等我赶到那里时，已经看不到他们了。在该处执勤的法国华捕似乎什么也没注意到，所以我向站在拐角处的一些中国人询问。
我被告知他们沿福煦路向麦尔西爱路方向跑去。此时，我已完全看不到那些人，于是我拦下一辆由中国人驾驶的卡车，命令他朝麦尔西爱路方向行驶。从福煦路到麦尔西爱路，我没有看到他们，但在麦尔西爱路上约 50 码处，我看到一群中国人散开，并听到一声枪响。我迅速驾车赶到现场，看到两名持枪的中国人向不同方向逃跑。我从移动的卡车上向其中一人开了 3 枪，距离约 20-30 码，但未击中，对方还击了一枪。停下

off the truck, I went after the assassin I had fired at, but
lost him in the huge crowd that had collected. I searched
round that area for a while without success. Then I heard
some Chinese say that the man was further up the road (Rue
Cardinal Mercier). I saw signs of excitement about 250 yards
along the road, so I commandeered the same K/Truck and drove
there. Approaching the spot, I overtook S.P.C. 671, who had
just fired a round on the run at a male Chinese, armed with
a gun, who was about 25 yards in front of him. I told the
driver of the truck to drive past both men, as quickly as he
could, meaning to cut off the assassin. He drove past about
20 yards and I ordered the truck stopped and was in the act
of jumping out, when I heard about 4 rounds fired. Running
back towards the firing, I saw that S.P.C. 671 had overtaken
and cornered the assassin at the intersection of Rue
Cardinal Mercier and Rue Prentice, bringing him down mortally
wounded. S.P.C. 671 then took a revolver from the hand of
the assassin and handed it to the undersigned. The French
Authorities were then informed and I took charge until the
arrival of Mr. T. Robertson, D.C. Crime, and D.I. Glover and
the French Police, to whom I handed over the revolver.

卡车后，我去追赶我刚才射击的那名刺客，但在聚集的大量人群中跟丢了他。我在该区域搜索了一会儿，没有结果。随后听到一些中国人说那人沿路（麦尔西爱路）更远处。我看到约 250 码外的路上有骚动迹象，于是我征用了同一辆卡车并驱车前往。接近该地点时，我超过了 671 号特别华捕，他刚才在奔跑中向一名持枪的中国男子开了一枪，该男子在他前方约 25 码处。我告诉卡车司机尽快从两人身边驶过，意在截断刺客的去路。司机驶过约 20 码后，我命令停车，正欲跳下车时，我听到大约 4 声枪响。我朝枪声方向跑回，看到 671 号特别华捕已在麦尔西爱路与普恩梯爱路路口追上并将刺客逼入死角，使其受致命伤倒地。随后 671 号特别华捕从刺客手中取下一支左轮手枪，并交给鄙人。随后通知了法国当局，在犯罪组副探长 T. Robertson 先生、侦探督察 Glover 以及法国警察到达之前，由我负责现场，随后我将左轮手枪移交给他们。

Zangchow              xx        D.S.I. Bugton
B'well          13-4-40             Inspt. Hsu Shing Ching

I am C.P.C. 1014 attached to the Traffic Office and
detached for duty in Chengtu Road District.
At about 9 a.m. 13-4-40 I stopped a H/truck on
Avenue Foch near Tamsui Road which I took to be overloaded.
I boarded the truck and ordered the driver to proceed to
Gordon Road Station. When the truck was turning north into
Moulmein Road near Avenue Foch I heard shooting intermingled
with Police whistles on Avenue Foch, west of Moulmein Road.
I jumped off the truck and saw two men running east on
Avenue Foch, at the same time firing with Mauser pistols at
two C.P.C.'s on the north side of the road who were pursuing
the armed men. I drew my pistol and loaded it and took up
the chase of the armed men. The armed men ran south along
Rue Cardinal Mercier and when near Rue Ratard I saw a third
man join the other two. At this time I had caught up with
the other police pursuing the armed men, one a S.P.C., one
a French C.P.C. and the other I am not sure of. As the armed
men ran two then armed with Mausers turned and fired at us.
We returned fire, I firing one shot.
On arriving at Rue Ratard I saw one man running east
and followed him, firing a second shot at him as I ran.
He was holding his right hand inside his long gown as though
he was holding a pistol. He was not running very fast and
I eventually overtook him and caught hold of his long gown
at the back of the neck , at the same time I fired one shot
into his buttock and brought him to the ground. I then knelt
down and placed my left leg across his neck and searched him

扬州              xx        副督察长 Bugton
B'well          1940年4月13日             督察 徐星清

本人系华捕编号 1014，隶属交通科，
被派往成都路警区执行任务。
1940年4月13日上午9时许，我在福煦路近淡水路处拦下一辆货车，
因认为其超载。
我登上货车，命令司机驶往戈登路巡捕房。当货车在福煦路附近向北转入莫利哀路时，我听到福煦路莫利哀路以西传来枪声，夹杂着警哨声。
我跳下货车，看见两名男子在福煦路上向东奔跑，
同时用毛瑟手枪向道路北侧追捕持械男子的两名华捕射击。我拔出手枪并上膛，加入对持械男子的追捕。持械男子沿梅神父路向南奔跑，当接近拉达路时，我看见第三名男子加入另外两人。此时我已赶上其他正在追捕持械男子的警察，其中一名是西捕，一名是法捕，另一人身份我不确定。当持械男子奔跑时，其中两名手持毛瑟枪的人转身向我们射击。
我们予以还击，我开了一枪。
到达拉达路时，我看见一名男子向东奔跑，
我便跟随他，并在奔跑中向他开了第二枪。
他右手藏在长衫内，仿佛握着手枪。他跑得不快，
我最终追上了他，从后面抓住他长衫的领口，同时我向他的臀部开了一枪，将其击倒在地。随后我跪下，左腿压住他的脖子并搜身

page_data.en:
- 2 -

and found a revolver inside his long gown. I then saw a
French C.I.C. No. 680 and called him over to assist me.
This C.I.C. came over and I asked him to telephone to a
police station, however he drew his pistol and fired at the
man on the ground wounding him in the leg. I remonstrated
with him for shooting at the man when I had already got him
under control, whereupon he said, "I will go and telephone".
During this time I questioned the man, asking what he had
done and he stated that he was a member of the Iron Blood
Association and had been sent to shoot a traitor at S. Ming
Tsung (Avenue Foch). I asked his particulars but he only
gave me his name as Dee Yoh (    ). Shortly afterwards
other French Police arrived on the scene together with
Settlement Police and took over. I did not see where the
other two armed men went nor what the Police who were
following them did.

在他长衫内发现一支左轮手枪。随后我看见一名
法租界探员编号 680，便叫他过来协助我。
这名探员走过来，我让他打电话给警察局，但他却拔出手枪向地上的男子射击，击中其腿部致其受伤。我抗议他在我也已控制住该男子的情况下向其射击，对此他说：“我去打电话”。
在此期间我审问该男子，问他做了什么，他声称自己是铁血团成员，奉命在S. Ming Tsung（福煦路）刺杀一名叛徒。我询问其个人资料，但他只告诉我他的名字是 Dee Yoh（音译）。不久后，
其他法国警察连同公共租界警察抵达现场并接管了局势。我没有看到另外两名持械男子去了哪里，也没有看到追捕他们的警察做了什么。

page_data.en:
A.C. 671, Sadhu Singh
India x D.S. Snuggs
Chengtu Road 13-4-40

My name is Sadhu Singh, son of Ram Singh, Village
Binjar, P.O. Office T lu ndi Riki, District Ludwiana.
I am attached to Chengtu Road Police Station and, on
the morning of 13-4-40 I was detailed for traffic post duty
at No. 3 Post (Avenue Foch and Moulmein Road corner) from
8 a.m. - 12 noon.
At about 9.15 a.m. my attention was attracted by four
male Chinese, who were running in an easterly direction
along the south footpath of Avenue Foch, towards me. On
their arrival at the intersection of Route Cardinal Mercier
and Avenue Foch, a distance of approximately 15 - 20 yards
away from me, I noticed that one of the above Chinese was
carrying a small black revolver in his right hand.
I immediately blew my whistle and chased the four male
Chinese, who had by this time turned into Route Cardinal
Mercier and were running in a southerly direction. The
chase continued along Route Cardinal Mercier for a distance
of about 100 yards. The above four Chinese then turned into
an alleyway on the west side of Route Cardinal Mercier,
I followed, however the alleyway in question was very short
and brought us out on to Route Cardinal Mercier again, at
this point I fired one round at the last of the fleeing
Chinese, the latter returned the fire, firing two shots at
me, at this stage I was joined by a French G.P.A. who also
opened fire. We then gained ground on the fleeing Chinese
and I fired 4 more shots which apparently took effect as one
of the Chinese fell to the ground wounded. On arrival at
page_data.zh:
助理巡官 671，Sadhu Singh
印度 x 副督察 Snuggs
成都路 1940年4月13日

本人名为 Sadhu Singh，Ram Singh 之子，籍贯 Binjar 村，邮局地址 T lu ndi Riki，Ludwiana 区。
本人隶属成都路巡捕房，于
1940年4月13日上午，我被指派在3号岗（福煦路与莫利哀路转角）执行交通岗位任务，时间为上午8时至中午12时。
上午9时15分许，我的注意力被四名中国男性吸引，他们正沿着福煦路南侧人行道向东朝我方向奔跑。当他们到达梅神父路与福煦路的交叉口时，距离我约15至20码，我注意到上述中国人中有一人右手持有一支小型黑色左轮手枪。
我立即吹响警哨并追赶这四名中国男性，此时他们已转入梅神父路并向南奔跑。追捕沿梅神父路持续了约100码。上述四名中国人随后转入梅神父路西侧的一条弄堂，我紧随其后，然而该弄堂很短，我们又回到了梅神父路上，在此处我向最后一名逃跑的中国人开了一枪，后者还击，向我开了两枪，此时一名法国特别警务人员（G.P.A.）加入我也开了火。随后我们缩短了与逃跑中国人的距离，我又开了4枪，似乎命中了目标，因为其中一名中国人受伤倒地。到达

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the wounded man I noticed that a small black revolver lay by
his side, I took possession of this.

Whilst stood over the wounded person, I was approached
by a foreigner whom I know to be a detective at Headquarters.
The latter took possession of the seized pistol.

I then proceeded together with the above detective to
a hospital in the French Concession from where I subsequently
left in an ambulance in company with the above detective and
a wounded Chinese, arriving at Changtu Road Police Station
at about 10.15 a.m. even date.

As I had received a slight wound on the left leg, I
reported the matter and was subsequently sent to the Police
Hospital where same was dressed and I was told to return to
the station for duty.

The above is my true statement.

Sd/- Godwin Wright,
S.P.C. (W)

伤者身边时，我注意到一把小型黑色左轮手枪躺在他身旁，我将其收缴。

当我站在伤者旁边时，一名外国人走近我，我知道他是总部的侦探。后者拿走了缴获的手枪。

随后我与上述侦探一同前往法租界的一家医院，之后我与上述侦探及一名受伤中国人乘坐救护车离开，于同日约上午10时15分抵达成都路巡捕房。

由于我左腿受轻伤，我报告了此事，随后被送往警察医院包扎伤口，并被告知返回警署执勤。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签署：- Godwin Wright，
西捕（白人）

My name is Aung Ung Liang, aged 39, native of
Yangchow, residing at No.70 Route Pere Dugout, French
Concession.

I was detailed for duty at Route Cardinal Mercier
and Rue Ratard between 8 a.m. to 12 noon on the 13.4.40.
At 9.15 a.m. I noticed four male Chinese wearing long gowns
and one other wearing short jacket and pants coming from the
International Settlement and turn east into Rue Ratard when
I heard police whistles. I then halted them. They fired
a number of shots at me and ran along Rue Ratard and entered
Siau Fong Wei. I immediately gave chase and returned fire,
whilst a Sikh Policeman of the S.M.P. also joined me. At
that time, three of the five decamped in an easterly direction.
I continued to chase the other two along Rue Ratard, Siau
Fong Wei, Route Cardinal Mercier and Route Prentice. I fired
7 shots in all during the chase and one of the bullets struck
one of the two on Route Prentice, but the other one made good
his escape. I caught the injured man and seized one broken
pistol butt, whilst the Sikh Policeman came along and picked
up a pistol. I then informed the police station by telephone.

Signature: Aung Ung Liang
French Policeman No.308.

本人名为陈宏良，39岁，扬州人，居住在法租界杜神父路70号。

1940年4月13日上午8时至中午12时，我被指派在梅神父路和拉达路执勤。
上午9时15分，我注意到四名身穿长衫的中国男性和另一名身穿短夹克和裤子的男子从公共租界方向走来，当我听到警哨声时，他们向东转入拉达路。我随即喝停他们。他们向我开了数枪，并沿拉达路奔跑进入小方围（音译）。我立即展开追击并还击，同时一名公共租界警务处的锡克教警察也加入了我。当时，五人中的三人向东逃窜。
我继续沿拉达路、小方围（音译）、梅神父路和普恩济路（音译）追赶另外两人。在追捕过程中我共开了7枪，其中一发子弹在普恩济路（音译）击中了两人中的一人，但另一人成功逃脱。我抓住了受伤男子，并缴获了一个断裂的手枪柄，此时锡克教警察走过来捡起了一支手枪。随后我用电话通知了巡捕房。

签名：陈宏良
法国警察编号308。

At about 9.15 a.m. on the 13.4.40, whilst I was on
duty outside No.755 Avenue Foch, S.P.C. 680, on duty at the

to inform me that four robbers were running east along Avenue

I observed four persons running on southern side-walk on

I imagine were fired from Mauser pistols. I returned two

On arrival at Rue Cardinal Mercier I lost sight

On reaching Rue Ratard the Indian policeman disappeared

1940年4月13日        翻译
               _______    书记员 徐 S. F.

1940年4月13日上午9时15分许，当我在福煦路755号外执勤时，在阿尔贝国王大道与福煦路交叉口执勤的西捕 680 前来告知我，有四名劫匪正沿福煦路向东奔跑。听到此消息后，我立即拔出配枪并上膛。我与西捕 680 一同开始追捕，跑了几秒钟后，我观察到四人在福煦路南侧人行道上奔跑。由于人行道上行人众多，我穿过马路继续追捕他们。到达福煦路与梅神父路交叉口时，其中两名劫匪发现被跟踪，因此向我们开了数枪，我想那是用毛瑟手枪发射的。我还击了两枪，在试图开第三枪时发现手枪卡壳，于是我吹响警哨，一名在福煦路与梅神父路交叉口执行交通任务的印度警察和一名公共租界西捕（编号不详）作出了响应。

到达拉达路时，印度警察不见了，我看见公共租界西捕跑向唯一一名躺在离梅神父路约20栋房屋远处的地上的劫匪。我随即冲上前协助这名中国警察控制受伤的劫匪，并从他身上缴获了一支手枪

At 9.15 a.m. on the 13.4.40, whilst on traffic duty

some of them continued to run south along Rue Cardinal

and at the same moment I opened fire at them. They exchanged
shots with us. As a result of the shooting affray I brought
down one of the gunmen, who was shot in the leg and collapsed
outside No. 301 Rue Ratard. After having been injured he
tried to stand up and run away and therefore I fired again

1940年4月13日上午9时15分，当我在福煦路与阿尔贝国王大道交叉口执行交通任务时，一名外国人走近我，向我报告说四名中国男性，其中两人持有武器，刚刚从我身边经过，在公共租界犯下了一起谋杀案。得知此事后，我关闭了信号灯，然后与这名外国人一同追赶这四名沿福煦路向东奔跑的男子。

听到我的警哨声，这四名歹徒立即转入梅神父路。
此时，一名在上述路口执勤的印度警察（公共租界）加入了我。
四名枪手向我们开火，但我们没有还击，因为这四人离我们距离很远，而且街上挤满了行人。到达福煦路735号时，另一名华捕编号 113（法国警察）加入了我们。

到达梅神父路与拉达路交叉口时，这四人突然分散，有些人继续沿梅神父路向南奔跑，而其他人则向东转入拉达路。

我跟随转入拉达路的人，并同时向他们开火。他们与我们互射。作为枪战的结果，我击倒了一名枪手，他腿部中弹，倒在拉达路301号外。受伤后他试图站起来逃跑，因此我再次开枪
